title: SPARS: A Stability-Plasticity-Aware Region Selection Framework for Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19876v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual learning aims to acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned knowledge. However, updating shared parameters when learning new tasks often overwrites existing knowledge, causing catastrophic forgetting. Memory replay methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting but rely on previous samples, raising privacy, memory, and scalability concerns. On the other hand, parameter isolation-based methods preserve learned knowledge but may limit knowledge transfer, whereas regularization promotes adaptability but remains susceptible to interference between old and new tasks. To maintain the stability-plasticity trade-off, this paper proposes Stability-Plasticity-Aware Region Selection (SPARS), a replay-free hybrid framework combining global parameter isolation with localized parameter regularization. translated_title: SPARS：一种面向持续学习的稳定性-可塑性感知区域选择框架
translated_abstract: 持续学习旨在获取新知识的同时保留先前学到的知识。然而，在学习新任务时更新共享参数往往会覆盖已有知识，导致灾难性遗忘。记忆回放方法可以缓解灾难性遗忘，但其依赖先前的样本，引发了隐私、内存和可扩展性方面的担忧。另一方面，基于参数隔离的方法能够保留已学到的知识，但可能限制知识迁移；而正则化方法虽然促进了适应性，但仍容易受到新旧任务之间干扰的影响。为了维持稳定性与可塑性之间的平衡，本文提出了稳定性-可塑性感知区域选择框架，这是一种无需回放的混合框架，将全局参数隔离与局部参数正则化相结合。SPARS 使用费雪信息矩阵（FIM）或一种新颖的置信度分数（CS）估计器来估计参数重要性。
tldr: SPARS是一种无需样本回放的持续学习混合框架，通过结合全局参数隔离与基于FIM或置信度分数估计器的局部参数正则化来选择关键参数区域，在保持旧知识稳定性的同时兼顾新任务的可塑性，从而缓解灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: SPARS is a replay-free hybrid continual learning framework that combines global parameter isolation with localized parameter regularization, selecting critical parameter regions via FIM or a novel Confidence Score estimator to balance stability and plasticity and mitigate catastrophic forgetting.
